piezas.titulo: Reading comprehension: Weather, climate and experiences
texto: Contextual reading of travel experiences in Thailand: read the conversation between two friends sharing their impressions of a visit to Chiang Mai. Notice how they describe the weather, the unexpected rain and the anecdotes from the trip.

pregunta.texto: Reading comprehension: According to the text, which idea does the sentence «ฝนที่ตกหนักติดต่อกันอาจทำให้เกิดน้ำท่วมขังบนถนนสายหลักบางแห่ง» express?

opciones.texto: Prolonged torrential rain can flood main city roads.
opciones.explicacion: Correct: this option translates and accurately interprets the sentence «ฝนที่ตกหนักติดต่อกันอาจทำให้เกิดน้ำท่วมขังบนถนนสายหลักบางแห่ง» from the text.

opciones.texto: Wearing clothes suited to the climate ensures a comfortable, pleasant stay.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this is another statement from the passage, not the meaning of the sentence in question.

opciones.texto: Watching the sunset over the sea leaves an unforgettable memory for the traveller.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this option corresponds to another sentence in the reading passage.

pregunta.texto: According to the reading, how does Mali assess her experience in Chiang Mai despite the rain and the heat?

opciones.texto: It was very fun and positive (การเดินทางสนุกมาก)
opciones.explicacion: Correct: Mali concludes enthusiastically, «แต่การเดินทางสนุกมากค่ะ».

opciones.texto: She regretted it because of the bad weather
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: she fully enjoyed the trip.

opciones.texto: She never travelled because she had no tickets
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: she travelled the previous year.

pregunta.texto: Read the sentence and choose its meaning.

opciones.texto: Yesterday it rained, so we stayed at home.
opciones.explicacion: The translation matches the Thai sentence.

opciones.texto: It was hot, but the trip was fun.
opciones.explicacion: This is another sentence on the same topic.

opciones.texto: Have you ever been to Chiang Mai?
opciones.explicacion: This sentence expresses a different idea on the same topic.

pregunta.texto: Complete the Thai sentence that expresses «Yesterday it rained, so we stayed at home.».
